_comment: Corpus B (docs/10-precision-plan.md): 20 ranked or loved osu! maps whose red lines were placed by hand, scored by bench/corpus_b.py. Only names and hashes are here; the audio and the maps stay in the user's own Songs folder and are never committed.
selection: Ranked, approved or loved in the local osu!.db on 2026-09-26 (read from a copy), and BeatmapSetID > 0 in the .osu.
No online offset and no local offset set on the difficulty in osu!.db.
Every difficulty of the set that plays this audio has the same red lines (offset to 1 ms, beat length to 0.001 ms, meter).
The truth difficulty is the one with the most hit objects; MP3 or OGG audio.
The precision plan's six categories in its counts (4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 2), spread over tempo (red lines from 47 to 257 BPM), length (90 s to 8 minutes of audio) and format (18 MP3, 2 OGG).

categories.edm: Constant-tempo EDM: one red line; the plan expects v3 to be exact here.
categories.rock-pop: Constant-tempo rock/pop: one red line on a band or pop production; v3 usually exact, sometimes the octave is wrong.
categories.live-drift: Live-band with drift: 200+ hand-placed red lines following a band that does not keep one tempo (Vampires-style).
categories.octave-swap: Verse/chorus octave swap: the map turns between a BPM and its double at section changes (the Sunday Cruise class).
categories.rubato-intro: Rubato intro then steady: several red lines of changing tempo before a steady body; the plan expects v3 to fall back.
categories.signature: Signature changes: the bar changes length (6/4 to 3/4, 7/4 to 4/4) while the beat stays.
